scope: General Android API26 ARM64 rand/srand/rand_r/random/srandom provider with private state and session reset. No package branches, native instruction patches or host PRNG state mutation.

observed_blocker.result: Earlier NRO reached rand after multibyte support and failed safely. This receipt verifies the new PRNG using host/compile evidence only. New product E2E must be read from a separate run bound to its exact NRO hash.

provenance.runtime: Independently written original AndroSwitch implementation of mathematical algorithm contracts. No upstream source text or initializer table copied.
provenance.oracle: Unchanged downloaded upstream random.c/rand_r.c compiled task-locally with symbol renames and compatibility headers. Full original BSD notices are retained in those ignored source files.
provenance.vectors: Fixed expected vectors in fixture generated by the independently compiled pinned upstream implementation, not by the new provider.
provenance.credits: AOSP/NetBSD algorithm references are explicit in source and fixture; existing RustyDroid attribution remains intact.

behavior.shared_stream: rand/random and srand/srandom aliases share one runtime-owned TYPE_3 stream: 31 uint32 words, separation3, modular addition then logical >>1.
behavior.seeding: Signed 32-bit Park-Miller initialization, 310 warm-up draws. Full unsigned input preserved; zero is distinct from one, as in API26 Bionic.
behavior.rand_r: Caller-owned uint32 LCG: seed*1103515245+12345 modulo2^32; returns low31 bits. Caller provides non-NULL valid pointer and synchronization if sharing that pointer.
behavior.threading: Global stream seed/draw/reset serialized with existing platform as_cxx_lock; rand_r has no shared provider state.
behavior.errno: Valid operations and reset preserve errno.
behavior.lifecycle: Existing as_bionic_libc_reset resets provider after thread/destructor quiescence; native.c unchanged by this subtask.
behavior.security: Deterministic non-cryptographic PRNG; no entropy or CSPRNG claim.
